title: 10-year Treasury yields stay near 5%, what would trigger the next break higher?
description: After all the hype and talk about the Fed, somehow stocks are finding some breathing room again. The Nasdaq closed at a record high on Monday as AI optimism returned, while the S&P 500 also posted a strong rebound. Lower oil prices and a mild retreat in Treasury yields have helped improve the mood after last week's volatility. title: Iran offers to reopen Strait of Hormuz within seven days if US eases blockade
description: Iran has offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if the United States takes steps to ease military and economic pressure on Tehran, according to a senior Iranian government official cited by Kyodo News . The proposal was reportedly conveyed to Washington through intermediaries as diplomatic efforts intensify around the UN General Assembly in New York. Under the proposal, Iran would reopen the strategic waterway if the US lifts its blockade of Iranian ports and announces a plan to halt military operations around the strait.
